summary: #smallpoems Be the small dog with a big stick determined to pass such joy in failure focus on need to move world forward grasping destiny in jaws future at your paws then it clicks with a turn of a head change of perspective stick advances
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Be the small dog with a big stick
determined to pass
such joy in failure
focus on need to move
world forward
grasping destiny in
jaws
future at your paws
then it clicks
with a turn of a head
change of perspective
stick advances
